chapter.nerocreatures.bestiary.title: Bestiary
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.pale_hunter: Lunar Stalkers hunt the dark plains of the moon. Bring down four and keep a little sinew as proof of the first entry in your bestiary.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.crystal_cla: A Crystal Golem is the crystalline worlds made to walk. Break one and record the refined crystal it leaves behind.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.jelly_logic: Plasma Slimes split, merge and somehow keep their charge. Study six of them and note the plasma cells they carry.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.first_conta: Something crawls out of the dark between worlds. Meet a Void Crawler and log a sample of the essence it is made of.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.scrap_right: Rogue Drones still patrol for owners long gone. Ground three and salvage the circuitry they leave behind.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.shield_brea: A Rogue Android hides behind its shield until it does not. Take one down and recover the core that kept it running.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.second_hand: Circuitry, plasma and an android core: put what the machines left behind to better use and assemble a drone shell of your own.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.boarding_pa: Space Pirates raid wherever there is something worth taking. Repel five of them and note what they were carrying.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.ember_crown: The Cinder Tyrant rules the ash of Cindara, and appears only rarely. Survive its phases, end the fight and keep the trophy.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.cindara_qui: A world record: the first time a Cinder Tyrant is defeated on Cindara, the ember world goes quiet for everyone on this server.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.field_guide: Golems, machines, pirates and a tyrant: your bestiary covers the creatures of Nerospace. A record of everything you have met out there.
Not everything out here wants you dead. Earn the trust of a Glacite Wisp or a Xertz Forager and tame your first companion.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.drone_deplo: A drone shell is only a shell until someone switches it on. Deploy your Terraforming Drone and give it a patch of ground to work.
quest.nerocreatures.bestiary.scrapyard.d: Drones, androids: the machines keep coming. Scrap ten mechanical foes of any kind and leave a scrapyard where they stood.
